decision.rationale: Linear fit on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 plus action-2 sustained-both has best BIC so far, and action-2 showed no_mismatch_observed (probe_rmse 0.0768c), but fitting is not independent confirmation nor mechanism. Sensor_lag and quadratic_loss have only been fit on initial-0,1,2; compare quadratic_loss numerically on the same full evidence including high-temperature sustained action-2 before spending scarce experiments (3 actions left, 5 fits left).
